_about: The rules a screenshot can decide, and the thresholds the audit judges them by (doc/design/AUDIT-FACTS.md sections 3 and 4). The site's figure 'the audit decides N rules' is derived from this file, and doc/design/audit/check-facts.js reads it: it prints these decisions and no others, and refuses a request to decide any other rule. A rule enters this file only when it is shown decidable from the facts, and a size is never a pass.

decisions.decides: body text below 4.5:1, judged at the worst end of the background; for rule 105, the contrast half only
text set below the reading floor of 12 pt (16 CSS px), as an upper bound; never a pass
